newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: M.Confianca contributes to BCP result.
newsitem.headline: M.Confianca contributes to BCP result.

text.p: The estimated contribution of insurer Mundial Confianca to the consolidated first half profits of Banco Comercial Portugues were 172 million escudos ($936,000), BCP chairman Jorge Jardim Goncalves said.
This figure is based on BCP's forecast that Mundial Confianca will post a 1997 profit of five billion escudos, Goncalves told a news conference.
BCP holds a 20 percent stake in Mundial Confianca, which is owned by businessman Antonio Champalimaud.
BCP's first half consolidated net profit grew 21 percent year-on-year to 13.121 billion escudos. ($ = 183.7 Portugese Escudos)
